product.title: 5 Top Highlights of Kyoto Full Day Bike Tour (E-bike option)

description.text: In Kyoto, this small-group bike or e-bike day leaves JR Saga-Arashiyama Station for five published highlights: Kinkaku-ji, Kiyomizu-dera Temple, Fushimi Inari-taisha Shrine, Arashiyama Bamboo Forest, and Gion. A cycling guide, bike, helmet, lunch, snacks, and listed admission fees are included for the seven-to-eight-hour loop covering up to 44 kilometers. The ride ends back at Saga-Arashiyama Station. Hotel pickup is not listed. The format suits visitors who want a guided bike window across shrine forest and downtown districts without renting independently. Meeting points are confirmed at booking in Kyoto, and the itinerary stays on Kinkaku-ji, Kiyomizu-dera, Fushimi Inari, and Arashiyama that define this ride rather than a Nara park add-on.

highlights: Full-day guided bike or e-bike loop across five Kyoto highlights
Kinkaku-ji, Kiyomizu-dera, Fushimi Inari, Arashiyama bamboo, and Gion

start.description: Meet at JR Saga-Arashiyama Station. Exit right at the ticket gates. The ride ends back at the same station.

end.description: Return to your Kyoto meeting point after the final stop on the itinerary.
